instruction: Set up automatic quoting of the original message when replying to emails in your Thunderbird account.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic quoting in Thunderbird reply settings. The evaluator checks the mail.identity.id1.auto_quote preference in prefs.js to verify it is set to true. Uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the Thunderbird preference 'mail.identity.id1.auto_quote' setting which directly corresponds to automatic quoting in replies
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling automatic quoting, evaluator verifies the exact preference that controls this feature
Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file fetches the prefs.js file from the correct Thunderbird profile path
Metric logic is correct: check_thunderbird_prefs parses JavaScript preferences file and checks the specific setting value against expected true
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird before verification to ensure settings are written to prefs.js file
Expected value is semantically correct: mail.identity.id1.auto_quote=true is the correct Thunderbird setting for enabling automatic quoting
Error handling: metric handles None result (file fetch failure) by returning 0.0
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Static type warning about Union return type is not a semantic issue - the metric correctly handles both str and None cases

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
